Terms & Conditions

The terms below govern your use of {{global.domain}} and any tree service work performed by Roubic Tree & Landscape LLC across NE Ohio. Please read them before engaging our services.

Effective July 2026 Governed by Ohio law

By using {{global.domain}} (the "Site") or engaging Roubic Tree & Landscape LLC ("Roubic") for tree service work, you agree to these Terms. Effective date: July 2026.

1. Services

Roubic provides tree removal, tree trimming and pruning, stump grinding, land clearing, storm damage and emergency tree service, and firewood delivery across NE Ohio (Cuyahoga and Geauga counties), operating from our Auburn Township, OH headquarters. Specific work is defined per job in the written estimate.

2. Estimates

All estimates are free and based on an in-person site walk. Estimates are valid for 30 days from the date issued. Roubic reserves the right to re-quote if the scope of work changes after the estimate is provided.

3. Pricing & Payment

Prices published on the Site are indicative ranges for typical NE Ohio conditions. The actual invoice is set per job by the written estimate. Payment terms are net-30 unless otherwise agreed in writing.

4. Insurance

Roubic maintains general liability and workers' compensation insurance. A Certificate of Insurance (COI) is available on request. Roubic does not operate without insurance.

5. Warranty & Workmanship

Our workmanship standard is set on a per-job basis. Roubic does not offer a blanket, multi-year workmanship warranty. Specific jobs may include written workmanship terms in the estimate. Emergency and storm-damage work may not carry the same aftercare terms as scheduled work.

6. Property & Damage

Roubic exercises reasonable care to prevent damage to non-target property. Damage arising from pre-existing conditions or subsequent acts of God is not covered.

7. Permits

Roubic coordinates permit applications with village building departments, including Pepper Pike, Chagrin Falls, Moreland Hills, Gates Mills, and others. Permit fees are passed through at cost.

8. Cancellation

You may cancel without penalty up to 24 hours prior to the scheduled work. For cancellations within 24 hours, Roubic may charge a mobilization fee.

9. Photos & Testimonials

By engaging our services, you grant Roubic a non-exclusive license to use before-and-after photos and quoted testimonials, unless you opt out in writing.

10. Limitation of Liability

Roubic's total liability for any claim is limited to the amount paid for the specific job giving rise to the claim.

11. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Ohio. Disputes are resolved in the courts of Geauga County, Ohio.
